function mountCornerBrackets(button, spec): () => void;

Defined in: core/utils/gpu/corner-brackets.ts:151

Mounts the corner-brackets widget inside button. The canvas is a position:absolute; inset:0 child — it follows the button's box for free, so only the backing size + arm lengths need mirroring.

Parameters

button

HTMLElement

The bracketed button/link element.

spec

CornerBracketSpec

Per-surface parameters (canvas class, hover inset, ease).

Returns

Teardown function; safe to call more than once.
